mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.title, u.nickname AS author_name, w.type, w.cover_url, w.latitude, w.longitude, w.location_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_likes wl WHERE wl.work_id = w.id) AS like_count, COALESCE(w.published_at, w.created_at) AS sort_time FROM works w LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = w.author_id WHERE w.status = 'published' AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude BETWEEN #{south} AND #{north} AND w.longitude BETWEEN #{west} AND #{east} ORDER BY COALESCE(w.published_at, w.created_at) DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
